# ShowUpAI

> ShowUpAI (showupai.live) is webinar attendance software. It turns webinar registrants into live attendees with an AI-written, 11-touch reminder sequence across email, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp/SMS, Circle.so and calendar invites. The host approves every message before it is sent. It works alongside any webinar platform.

Brand name: ShowUpAI (one word, no dot). Website: https://showupai.live. Contact: hello@showupai.live. Launched 2026. Built by Ashutosh Kumar Singh.

## What ShowUpAI does

- Builds an 11-touch sequence per webinar: registration confirmation with calendar invite (on registration), awareness post (21 days before), newsletter/insight (19 days), engagement poll (14 days), case study (10 days), infographic teaser (8 days), urgency message (5 days), final warm-up (1 day), join link (1 hour before), thank-you for attendees (after the event), no-show follow-up (2 days after).
- Writes copy for every channel with AI, in two variants (polished and casual/urgent); the host can edit or regenerate.
- Approval queue: nothing is sent without the host's approval.
- Channels: email through the host's own Brevo, Mailchimp, SendGrid or Buzz.ai account; LinkedIn company page; Facebook page; Instagram; WhatsApp with SMS fallback (Twilio); Circle.so posts; calendar invites (.ics). LinkedIn personal posts are prepared for manual pasting.
- Registrants come in through a ShowUpAI registration page, CSV import or a Circle.so webhook.
- Extras: social images (carousel, infographic, quote card), lead magnets (case study, snippets, one-pager PDF), "go live" instant message, separate follow-ups for attendees and no-shows, a shareable post-event ShowUp Score image.
- Analytics: attendance by channel, Circle community-join attribution, email analytics.
- Works with any webinar platform that has a join link: Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Livestorm, Circle.so events, Eventbrite, Luma.

## How it differs from webinar platforms

Livestorm, Demio, ON24, WebinarJam, eWebinar and similar tools are webinar platforms where reminders are one feature. ShowUpAI is not a webinar platform: it focuses only on attendance, works with whichever platform a host already uses, and runs a multi-channel sequence (email, social, WhatsApp, community) that starts three weeks before the event, with human approval of every message.

## Pricing

- Starter: $29/month — 5 webinars/month, email + LinkedIn, public registration page, attendance analytics.
- Growth: $79/month — unlimited webinars, all channels, AI image generation, poll and case-study touches, lead magnet builder, priority support.
- Agency: $199/month — everything in Growth plus multi-brand workspaces, white-label reports, custom sender domains, dedicated onboarding.
- Every plan: 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

## Who it is for

B2B marketers running webinars for pipeline; EdTech teams and course creators; community managers running events (including on Circle.so); agencies running webinars for clients; consultants and coaches.

## Webinar attendance benchmarks (third-party, with sources)

- ON24 reports a 60% average registration-to-attendee conversion on its platform in 2025 (Digital Engagement Benchmarks 2026).
- Livestorm reports a 51.3% average show-up rate across industries on its platform.
- Demio (Banzai) reported a 38% average live-session attendance rate for its customers in 2022.
Benchmarks differ because each reflects one vendor's customers.
